finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit 0.

Two real bugs, not noise. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`. The bump renamed that to `retryCount`. It now takes either. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off.

The 8 warnings are canned strings in `build.js`. They name files that do not exist.

Next: nothing.
